_comment: TEMPLATE — not a real stage. Do not count this file as a Stage AREA-SPEC.
Copy this into docs/bsh/scenario/<sector>/<stage>/AREA-SPEC.json and fill in real,
reviewed values only. Every number/id below is a placeholder — do not treat it as
confirmed design data. See docs/bsh/scenario/AREA-SPEC-AUTHORING-STANDARD.md for the
full field-by-field contract, the known preset/system registry, and the reasons behind
each rule (local IDs, no world-global coordinates, no duplicated grapple data, etc.).
IMPORTANT: `stage.sourceAreaId` is a legacy Area authoring-source ID, NOT the final Runtime
identity. The default product Runtime (Seamless Sector Landmark compiler) derives the
— do not add a landmarkId field here, it would just duplicate what's already derivable.
npm run validate:area-specs will NOT flag this file as a stage error, because it does
not live at docs/bsh/scenario/<sector>/<stage>/AREA-SPEC.json — but it also will not be
schema-checked for that reason. Validate your copy after renaming/relocating it.

surfaces._comment: preset must be a KNOWN Runtime surface kind, or declared under runtimeDependencies.newSystems. The preset also determines which coordinate anchor the validator checks real extent against (see AUTHORING-STANDARD §6) — do not add an explicit anchor field.

grappleTargets._comment: One entry covers both the grapple-target surface AND the grapple-landmark object — do not author them twice.
grappleTargets.label: A

enemies._comment: Remove this entry entirely if the stage has no enemies (most Rest / Reveal stages don't).

scannerGroups._comment: controlledTargets must reference grappleTargets ids declared above. A target may belong to only one group.

route._comment: runtimeLandmarks = candidate authored routePoints, MUST reference real entities (entry/surfaces/grappleTargets/enemies/"exit") — an unknown id here is a validation FAIL, not a free-form label. mandatory = flat id list, must be clearable with swingImpulse=0. optional = named alternate sequences (id + ordered id list). forbiddenBypasses = geometry that must NOT allow a progression skip, one entry per forbidden shortcut.

forbiddenBypasses.reason: must not skip the mandatory Anchor A commit

sourceExit._comment: Legacy source-layer input only — the minimal fields AreaDefinition.exitBlock() needs to build the authored Area (deck/door/panel/gate) that gets imported into a Sector landmark. This is NOT the Runtime's actual progression authority — see `progression` below. Do not author deck/exit/panel/gate objects separately.

progression._comment: The Seamless Sector Runtime's real progression authority: an objective-gated connector between this Stage's compiled landmark and the next. targetStageAlias is null ONLY for a genuine content boundary (e.g. a Sector's last Stage before a Boss/Post-Sector transition).

story._comment: planningTriggers = scenario-planning inventory only (mirrors defineArea().storyTriggers; the Assembler does not expose this as runtime state). runtimePresentations = story-display trigger-cue objects only; entry/objective/gate presentations are already implied by stage.legacyStageAlias / objectives[].id / progression.

runtimeDependencies._comment: required = system/profile that ALREADY exists in Runtime and this Stage depends on (informational, but the id must be a KNOWN name). newSystems = NOT YET implemented; anything referenced above (preset/profile/runtimeModel/progression.mode) that isn't in the validator's known registry MUST be declared here with status NOT_IMPLEMENTED, or validation fails.
